Display a workstream transition. If id is provided, show that transition;
otherwise list

workstream_transition and show the first.



Respects field-level read permissions (BLI-642). Output format via --format.

  Show first workstream transition
  zqk.test object wstrans show
  Show by ID
  zqk.test object wstrans show WST-001
  Show in JSON format
  zqk.test object wstrans show --format json

Usage:
  zqk.test object wstrans show [flags]

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
